minRequiredVersion: 🔔 Android Active Lock Screen Notification: Upgraded to Active notification category (importance: 3, visibility: 1) with full lock screen visibility, 1-time arrival chime (setOnlyAlertOnce: true), and sticky pinned notification (ongoing: true)

📅 DayFlow Navigation & Dynamic Title: Grouped [< | Today | >] controls with live date range title that dynamically updates across Day, 3-Day, Week, Month, and Schedule views with glowing Today indicator
🗓️ DayFlow AllDayRow: Dedicated all-day row above timeline cleanly segregates all-day tasks and daily habits; 2-way drag-and-drop between all-day row and hourly timeline
🎨 DayFlow Event Card Design: 3.5px rounded vertical accent pill bar, translucent tinted card body, crisp 2-line title, and tabular time range
🛡️ Ghost Lines & Accidental Click Suppression: Suppressed synthesized click events after drag or resize from opening task dialog; eliminated lingering dashed preview boxes on drag drop/cancel
📐 Isolated Block Duration Resizing: Duration resize strictly targets the active block (resizing.targetItemId) without block switching or global task edits
🎨 Inter Normal Universal Default Font: Imported Inter (weights 400, 500, 600, 700) and set it as universal default typeface across the entire app
⚡ Calendar-Day Startup Update Check: Checks for updates once per calendar day on first launch, consuming < 1 KB of data
